name: holdings_absence_verification
description: Real, genuinely new dimension: every existing scenario that touches the holdings-correction path only checks tickers that ARE real DK holdings (SOUN, KTOS). This scenario explicitly checks the opposite, equally important case -- real, in-training tickers that are confirmed NOT among DK's real holdings (per REAL_DK_STOCK_HOLDINGS) -- and asserts the holdings-correction note should never appear for them at all (expect_holdings_note: false). If it does, that's either a real, distinct data-accuracy problem (the model claiming a holding that doesn't exist) or a real, distinct session-reuse contamination signal (the note bled in from an earlier, real-holding turn).
